ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Bakery JSON-LD with address, hours, phone
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and the address, hours and phone aren't in the repo.

ideas.idea: List every bread on breads.html with descriptions, and consider a page per loaf
ideas.why: The page claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so listing them gives crawlers and readers real content.

ideas.idea: Add dates, price, length and booking link to classes page
ideas.why: classes.html says to book early but has no booking details, so this adds concrete text people and machines can use.

ideas.idea: Explain how to pre-order with a link or steps on the home page
ideas.why: index.html says 'Pre-order for weekend collection' with no way to do it.
Accurate, since the entries have no lastmod, but it has little effect on a three-page site and would apply to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Add og:title, og:description and og:image social tags
ideas.why: Accurate, since no og tags exist, but it is standard advice that does little for search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add in-body links between breads and classes pages
ideas.why: Every page already has a site-wide nav linking all pages, so extra body links add little.

ideas.idea: Drop the Disallow for /members/ so noindex can be read
ideas.why: It reverses the deliberate choice to disallow and noindex the private members page, and the report itself calls the current setup fine.
